variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit/redesign the supplied ORIGINAL game concept screenshot. Preserve its distinctive dark cut-paper folklore visual identity: parchment ivory, charcoal woodcut silhouettes, muted vermilion, restrained slate blue, rough ink edges, small red-scarf lantern knight facing three shadow creatures, ruined orchard and pale moon. This is our fictional indie Godot 2D side-view tactical auto-battler. Do NOT copy any commercial game's characters or decorative UI. Keep all visible text in clean, highly legible Simplified Chinese except AP and RP. Sophisticated desktop Steam game layout, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560x1440. Beautiful and usable, aligned layout with generous padding, restrained paper grain behind text, strongly contrasting dark body text. No tiny paragraphs, no collage, no device frame. Resource colors use vermilion AP and slate blue RP WITH labels and different symbol shapes. Original four gigantic cards and sequential arrows are to be replaced: priority is NOT a fixed sequential combo. This is a design mockup, not functional software.
Primary request: a complete revised pre-battle tactics screen emphasizing skill rules, prioritization and counterattack. Top 5% header "战前战术" with top-right "第 03 战". Upper 25% is the same original side-view battlefield, reduced in height but wide and still evocative, enemy intentions and health visible. No attack trajectory, game is paused for setup.
Below battlefield, a clean slim hero strip: "巡夜人"   "生命 42 / 60"   red diamonds "行动 AP 3 / 3"   blue circular beads "反应 RP 3 / 3".
Lower 58% screen is one FULL-WIDTH parchment tactics table, no side panels. Seven rigorously aligned columns with headers "优先级" | "技能" | "消耗" | "触发时机" | "附加条件" | "作用目标" | "启用". Small carved skill icons beside names, six-dot drag handle and priority number on each row, compact checked toggle in final column. Separate into two distinct bands, each THREE roomy rows. Red header band "主动行动 · 自身行动时，执行首条可用规则". Rows exactly:
"01" | "包扎" | "1 AP" | "自身行动时" | "自身生命 < 40%" | "自身" | enabled.
"02" | "处决" | "2 AP" | "自身行动时" | "目标生命 ≤ 30%" | "生命最低的敌人" | enabled.
"03" | "斩击" | "1 AP" | "自身行动时" | "无附加条件" | "最近的敌人" | enabled.
Blue header band "被动反应 · 对应事件发生时，按优先级判定". Rows exactly:
"01" | "护身" | "1 RP" | "受到攻击前" | "本次为物理攻击" | "自身" | enabled.
"02" | "应急治疗" | "1 RP" | "自身受伤后" | "自身生命 < 25%" | "自身" | enabled.
"03" | "反击" | "1 RP" | "自身受伤后" | TWO clearly joined chips "自身生命 > 40%" "且" "RP ≥ 2" | "本次攻击者" | enabled.
Counterattack row selected with narrow slate-blue left border and subtle blue paper tint, no neon glow. Trigger labels have tiny lock icons indicating skill-defined timing; condition chips and eligible target dropdowns are clearly editable. Reaction-only locked target "本次攻击者" has a tiny lock as well. Strong vertical group distinction, NOT arrows between skills. In bottom footer left show a small info icon and "同一事件窗口最多发动一个反应技能". Bottom right two actual buttons "试演战术" and dominant vermilion "开始战斗". Do not add new labels or controls or ornamental filler. Keep table readable with all six rows visible, intentionally spend image area on rules instead of portrait decoration.

Primary request: a second UI screen demonstrating editing the COUNTERATTACK rule and understanding why it triggers. The battlefield and tactics list exist as a subdued background matching original art, with a large centered parchment editor occupying about 80% width and 85% height, bordered with tasteful torn black ink edges. This is a legible detailed in-game rule editor, not an infographic.
Top modal header small returning-arrow sword icon, large title "反击", a slate-blue category tag "被动反应", and cost "消耗 1 RP", top-right close X.
Two-column editor: left 62% width has four generously spaced numbered sections with short exact labels:
1 "触发时机" with locked blue-grey chip "自身受到伤害后" and small caption "由技能决定".
2 "附加条件" with one row of real form widgets: dropdown "自身生命" comparator ">" numeric field "40" suffix "%" ; below it a clear connector "且"; second real widget row dropdown "当前 RP" comparator "≥" numeric field "2". Below short subtle caption "全部满足才发动".
3 "作用目标" locked chip "本次攻击者".
4 "触发限制" two small labels "每次攻击最多一次" and "反击不再触发反击".
Right 38% width is a soft slate tinted parchment inset titled "规则试演". Include a clean scenario mini-card with big values "受伤后生命 60%" and "当前 RP 2". Underneath show three short checkmark lines with distinct circular symbols: "时机满足" / "生命 > 40%" / "RP ≥ 2". One thin connector leads to a small woodcut illustration of red-scarf knight retaliating against an antler shadow, then outcome label "发动反击" and resource label "消耗后 RP 1". Below a smaller second example shows "当前 RP 1" with an outlined skip icon and label "跳过：保留反应点". The two scenarios must be clearly separated, the skip example does not alter the success example above.
Bottom of the modal has a narrow readable natural-language summary: "受伤后，生命高于 40% 且 RP 至少为 2 时，反击攻击者。"
Bottom-right buttons secondary "取消" and strong vermilion primary "保存规则".
Important: differentiate fixed timing from configurable condition and locked target. This design uses proposed resources AP and RP, not PP. Balanced spacious type, real Chinese form controls. Preserve cut-paper style without textured noise obscuring characters. No glowing digital dashboard, no node graph, no premium fantasy gold chrome.

overviewCorrection:

1. All SIX cells in the column labeled "触发时机" have lock icons, so remove the small downward dropdown chevron at the right edge of each of those six cells. Preserve their lock icons and exact text. They must look like read-only fixed skill timing. Also remove the dropdown chevron from the selected "反击" row's locked target cell "本次攻击者". Keep dropdown chevrons on editable conditions and other editable target cells.
2. Replace the bottom-left footnote with exact text "每名角色在同一事件窗口最多发动一个反应技能", readable with sufficient width and padding. Preserve adjacent buttons.
3. Replace only the lightning-bolt icon beside "反击" with a small white sword plus curved returning arrow on the same slate-blue square. This must visually communicate counterattack.
No other changes. Maintain original 16:9 dimensions, dark paper-cut and parchment style, crisp Chinese UI.
